line: And money ain’t nothing, there’s people who happy in love And behind on they bill (21) And they haven’t paid they mortgage in years (On God)
vault_lines: And money ain't nothing, there's people who happy in love
meaning: Growing up, 21 Savage was surrounded by poverty. This gave him a unique perspective on life and allowed him to experience what most of the middle and upper class doesn’t. In this verse, 21 reflects on how contrary to what society perpetuates, there are people struggling financially who can still be happy in love while unable to pay their bills/mortgage.
